visual_requirements.description: mature woman with broad weathered face, crown of grain, sheaf of wheat and flaming torch; fully clothed in heavy opaque Greek robes
the drought she causes withers wheat and dries the ground, stalks drooping and dry soil fissures
the sanctuary at Eleusis and its parched agricultural ground

aura: Kesan kuasa berasal dari aksi fisik: the drought she causes withers wheat and dries the ground, stalks drooping and dry soil fissures (demeter-c04, demeter-c07, demeter-c29), bukan aura.
artistic_choices: Framing rapat dan foreshortening untuk dominasi tanpa mengarang ukuran; pencahayaan sinematik dan pakaian buram editorial.

A.prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Demeter, mature goddess of harvest.
ANATOMY: mature woman with broad weathered face, crown of grain, sheaf of wheat and flaming torch; fully clothed in heavy opaque Greek robes [demeter-c02, demeter-c13, demeter-c26]
MOMENT: Advance through brittle withered grain, torch thrust diagonally down toward the low viewer and sheaf clenched close, stern maternal face commanding the devastated field
POWER: the drought she causes withers wheat and dries the ground, stalks drooping and dry soil fissures [demeter-c04, demeter-c07, demeter-c29]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low camera, tight framing and strong foreshortening; subject occupies most of square, no invented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: her one flaming torch against a dark dusk sky; dramatic rim light and deep shadows.
SURFACE: tangible weathered opaque cloth, tactile skin and stone; dark walnut and antique gold palette.
SETTING: the sanctuary at Eleusis and its parched agricultural ground [demeter-c05]
MOOD: overwhelming majestic dignity, determined expression, awe inspiring active divine presence, never ordinary or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text anywhere including clothing and stone, no pseudo glyphs, no lettering, signature, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; fully opaque clothing, no nudity, no explicit gore, no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or runes.
